title: Compose and dispatch alert policies
instructions: Create an AlertRule interface with matches(int). HighAlert matches readings strictly above its threshold; LowAlert matches readings strictly below its threshold.

Use a small abstract ThresholdAlert to hold the shared immutable threshold, with constructor chaining through super. RuleSet composes a list of AlertRule objects and counts matching rules for a reading.
The threshold base is justified only by shared state; RuleSet has rules and is not itself a subtype of the threshold class. Explain static interface type versus runtime implementation.
DelftStudy authored practice. The time class is a suggested practice budget, not an official assessment duration.
Write and review your own attempt before revealing the reference. Code on this page is ephemeral and is not compiled, run or automatically graded. Multiple correct implementations are valid.

requirements.text: Use the interface and an abstract shared-state base correctly, including super constructor chaining and immutable threshold state.
Override matches(int) with strict high/low behavior and explain why a call through AlertRule uses the actual object implementation.
Compose a defensive list of rules; reject null rules and keep matching independent of console input.
Test threshold equality, mixed rules, an empty rule list and caller mutation of the original list.
